lines.zh: 石臂砸在地上，一步一个坑。
lines.en: Stone arms pound the ground, a pit per step.
Vapor seeps from my armor seams.

lines.zh: 我拖着半截铁链走过去。
lines.en: I drag a broken chain along.
The wet prints behind me dry slowly.
Something inside me boils water.

lines.zh: 我走得很沉，像一场涨潮。
lines.en: I move heavily, like a rising tide.

lines.zh: 肩膀上的礁石互相摩擦。
lines.en: The reef stones on my shoulders grind.
Every plate is alive.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，草都咸了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass turns salt-bitter.
The damp air pushes along with me.
Standing, steam rising off my back.
I listen to the noise of the sea floor.
A small shell is wedged in my seams.
Water turns in circles inside me.
This body is slowly growing.
My breath tastes of salt.
Fire and sea have made peace in me.
I wait for the next high tide.
The vines on the reef stone flinch.
Standing alone, the ground turns wet.

lines.zh: 帆索在风里响，又一条船来了。
lines.en: Rigging creaks on the wind — another ship is coming.
My joints turn, slowly.
I will take this land over.
Water keeps dripping.

lines.zh: 我的影子在潮气里变形。
lines.en: My shadow distorts in the damp.
I have not reached full tide yet.
You are standing in water.
Seaweed still clings to my armor.

lines.zh: 看我的眼睛，是两个水洼。
lines.en: My eyes are two pools of water.
You are dry as a stone.
Everything within thirty blocks is mine.

lines.zh: 你听见里面的水声了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the water inside me?
I will drag you under.
Where does this road lead?
Your feet are slipping back.

lines.zh: 你身上的味，我在海沟里闻过。
lines.en: I have smelled your kind before, down in the trench.

lines.zh: 站着别动，我在称你的分量。
lines.en: Stand still; I am weighing what you're worth.
This place used to be dry.
A plate breaks; water seeps in.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，潮退了半寸。
lines.en: I sway, and the tide pulls back an inch.
Steam bursts from the wound.
That wound will grow back.
My water is clouded.
Pain is the sound of the sea.
One step back cracks the floor.
Some reef stone falls away.
I remain. So does the sea.
You will be soaked soft.
The damp in the air is thick.
This body needs water.
That bucket in your hand. Give it.
Something salty. I want that more.
I came here to feed.

lines.zh: 这一带的活物，都算食物。
lines.en: Every living thing here counts as food.
Pour the water on the stone.
I can feel the groundwater.
Do not bring fire. Water will do.
Your blood is water too.

lines.zh: 你的骨头在礁石上响了一下。
lines.en: Your bones clicked on my reef stone.
Get back. You are blocking the tide.
I do not dodge. The water compensates me.
You collided into my vines.
That force is a wave on rock.
You back away, and the ground wets.
Do not walk against my plates.
Stand aside. You are in the way.
There is water all under your feet.
I barely even swayed.
That too grows on my body.
The tide will bring others of my kind.

lines.zh: 我不需要你这样的回答。
lines.en: I do not need that sort of answer from you.
Only in the water could we speak of it.
Even my limbs are scavenged.
Let me finish growing first.
The sea has no such thing.
The vines will not loosen for that.
The tide does not speak of this.
The tide has pulled back.
I pick up a conch shell.
What lies on the stone is mine.
Water pours off me as I bend.
This thing tastes of salt.
I wedge it into a seam.
Pick it up and see what it is.
Not food. I put it down.
My plates are thick; my fingers cannot reach.
It dissolved in my palm.
I collect everything here.
You have crossed the tide line.
Your scent is in my plates.

lines.zh: 你踩过的湿地，已经把位置说了。
lines.en: The wet ground you crossed has already told me where you are.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片陆地归海。
lines.en: As of today, this land belongs to the sea.
You count as food.
Every plate of mine turns toward you.
Do not run toward the sea.
This is the beginning of the surge.
My steps will catch you.
The air on you is warm.
I smell something alive.
A large target. Good.
I have closed this road.
Water starts to creep at your feet.
Come. The sea wants to eat.
You are what I waited for.
There is no turning back now.
The water level is rising.
I stand, and the water still rises.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，留下一道水痕。
lines.en: Every step you take leaves a wet trail.
The damp wraps your ankles.
I wait for the water to reach your knees.
Step back, and I seep forward.
Every seam of mine breathes.
This body is storing up.
You tremble. Cold?
A moment more, then I am faster.

lines.zh: 我的影子和水连在一起。
lines.en: My shadow joins with the water.
I watch your feet hunt dry ground.
Good. You are caught.

lines.zh: 水的声音盖过你的脚步。
lines.en: The water drowns out your steps.
I wait for your strength to run out.
The fire inside me recedes.
Just a little closer.

lines.zh: 甲缝里的水满了，可以动了。
lines.en: The water in my seams is full — I can move now.
The waves push in, layer by layer.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经陷进土里。
lines.en: My fingers have sunk into the soil.
Then try me.
A stone fist falls, scattering water.
Vines wrap his legs.
A palm slams his chest.
Water begins to seep from him.
That punch came with the tide.

lines.zh: 礁石边缘割开了他的皮。
lines.en: Reef edge opened his skin.
I shove, and he slides.
Water wells up under his feet.
My plates close in.
He hit back. Lightly.
That leaves him unsteady.
I catch his arm.
The strength of stone and water.
When I recoil, I drip.
The tide pushes me onto land.
Water still runs off my plates.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的位置站起来。
lines.en: I rise where the wreck lies.
This land lacks a master.
The steam arrives before I do.
As I rise, the reef stones loosen.
Whose footprints are these on the shore?
Fire and sea open their eyes together.
My body is still growing.
Seawater seeps into every seam.
Your world is not damp enough.
I brought the trench up with me.
My breath withers the grass.
This place begins at my feet.
I searched long for this place.
The ground is sinking.
Do not stand so near me.
The tide has come in.
I have brought the sea.
The tide is in. Move.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，暂时焦了。
lines.en: Fire scorches my plates, briefly.

lines.zh: 从高处砸下，礁石散了一地。
lines.en: Falling from height scatters reef stone.

lines.zh: 水是我的家，我在这里更强。
lines.en: Water is my home. Here I am stronger.
The blast loosens my plates.

lines.zh: 箭插进湿甲里，滑出来了。
lines.en: The arrow sank in wet plate and slid out.
Even the sea does not know this power.
Too long from water, I crack dry.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，水从我甲缝里导电。
lines.en: Lightning falls and the water in my seams carries it through me.
No water here. Only falling.
